# Fix round 3: the last open findings of the iPhone and tablet passes

Date: 2026-11-19. Branch `feature/theming-native`, local commits only. Device: iOS simulator "iPhone 17 Pro" (`558440F2-...`), Debug build from Metro 8097, local API, project `development`. Screenshots: `<scratchpad>/pass4/ios/NN-*.png` (scratchpad = `/private/tmp/claude-502/-Users-work-Ordering-ordering-app-business-theming/3f70efc6-0154-439f-b577-4c786cf37ae6/scratchpad`); every one opened and looked at. No tablet, no Android, no iPhone rotation here: item 7 is a test only. No message of the coordinator with the second Android pass or the third tablet look arrived while this round ran, so none of those findings are in it.

Verdicts: **fixed** (cause in a line, files, how it was seen) / **not a defect** / **not reproduced** / **could not fix**.

| # | Verdict | Cause, files, evidence |
|---|---|---|
| 1 Messages list stale after an action of the app (class B) | **fixed; seen for an action from the details, tested for one from a card** | Two causes. (a) `MessagesOption` listened to nothing: it now hears `ORDER_CHANGED_EVENT` and takes the new **status** into the row (`applyStatusToRows` in `OrdersOption/orderChanges.ts`; the row's unread counts and last message stay the conversation's). (b) The orders list applied the actions taken on **its own cards** (accept, ready, picked up) straight to its lists and never emitted the event, so only the details' actions (which emit) reached other screens. The list now emits the event for its own actions and hears it with the same handler as every other screen's (`useOrdersSplit.ts`): one mechanism, no second one. Ids compare as numbers (`sameOrder`) instead of `===`. Tests: `MessagesOption.live.test.tsx` (the row follows, no refetch, unread kept, string id), `orderChanges.test.ts`, `useOrdersSplit.test.tsx` ("tells the app with the one event and hears it itself"); the jest event bus now dispatches `emit` to `on` handlers like the real emitter (`jest/helpers/mockOrdering.js`). **Seen:** #3114 marked ready from its details, then the Messages tab: its row read "Ready for pickup" at once (`15`). **Seen before the card fix, i.e. the bug itself:** the same order picked up from its card, Messages still read "Ready for pickup" (`16`, taken with the old code in memory). **Not seen after the fix:** an action from a card followed by Messages (no data left in the budget); jest only |
| 2 The filtered list once stayed stale (fix-round2 item 1) | **reproduced on the first try, cause found, fixed** | Sequence as asked: search "Pickup", three card accepts (#3569, #3568, #3567), then #3567 opened from the list and "Mark ready for pickup" from its details, back: the card still drew "Mark ready for pickup" and stayed so for minutes (`07`-`09`, `12`). **Cause:** the details controller writes the server's answer into the order it is given (`Object.assign(orderState.order, result)` in the shared `OrderDetails`), and `OrderDetailsPage` gave it **the list's own object** (`route.params.order`). The card therefore held status 4 before the list was told; when the event came, the card's memo compared the (already mutated) previous order with the new one, found no difference and kept the old drawing. It looked intermittent because anything else that re-rendered the card (a clock, a counter) hid it. The overlay, the string/number id and the replaced filtered array were not the cause (a time change of #3568 still reached its card). **Fix:** `OrderDetailsPage` hands the controller a copy, kept while the list's object is the same (`useMemo`), so the lists' objects are never written by the page (`OrderDetails/OrderDetailsPage.tsx`). Test `OrderDetailsPage.listOrder.test.tsx` (fails with the old line). **Seen after the fix:** a second order (#3114) marked ready from its details inside the same filtered search: its card read "Not picked up / Picked up" and "Ready for pickup" at once (`14`). Not repeated three times: the data budget allowed one more details action |
| 3 Subtotal duplicates Total (class C) | **fixed** | The bill drew the Subtotal row always. It is now a row only when another line (discount, tax, fee, delivery fee, driver tip) stands between it and the total or when the amounts differ by a cent; with nothing to say the bill has no rows, no divider over the Total, and a folded total with nothing under it does not fold (`OrderDetails/OrderBill.tsx` `useBillRows`, `PaymentCard.tsx`). Test `OrderBill.test.tsx`. **Seen:** #3567 ready pickup (`07`, `08`): "Total ... $ 15,00" alone, as `OrderReadyPickup`; #4467 pending delivery (`17-history-filtered`, a tap that opened its details): Subtotal, Tax, Service fee, Delivery Fee over the Total, as `OrderPending` |
| 4 Tonal search button 11 pt past the gutter (class C) | **fixed** | Orders header only (`OrdersOption`; the board's header does not pull its buttons). `ONavbar rightButtons` pulls the end group by `closeButtonInset` so a **ghost** glyph sits at the gutter; with a filter on the button is **tonal**, a visible box, so its box hung 11 pt past the notice and the cards. `rightButtons` is now off while a filter is on, so the filled box ends at the gutter (`OrdersOption/index.tsx`). Test in `OrdersOption.test.tsx` (fails without the change). **Seen:** `02`, `09`: the tonal box's right edge is the notice's and the cards' (x 382 in the accessibility tree, as the gutter). The glyph moves 11 pt left when a filter goes on, a visible change on a screen that the search page covers while it happens |
| 5 Status names are the server's long words | **fixed** | Three tables wrote statuses: `getOrderStatus` (details, Messages, map through `statusLabel`), `orderStatusList` (cards, History) and the chat's `orderStatusNames` ("Order status accepted by restaurant"). Now one: `shared/orderStatusName.ts`; `statusLabel`, `orderStatusList`, the cards (`OrderCard`, `GroupedOrderCard` call `statusLabel`) and the chat's pills read it. The mockups' words: "Picked up by customer" (`OrdersHistory`), "Picked up by driver" (`OrderDelivery`), "Accepted by business", "Rejected by business", "Completed". New keys `STATUS_PICKED_UP_BY_CUSTOMER`, `STATUS_NOT_PICKED_UP_BY_CUSTOMER`, `STATUS_PICKED_UP_BY_DRIVER`, `STATUS_PICKUP_FAILED_BY_DRIVER`, `STATUS_DELIVERED_BY_DRIVER`, `STATUS_DELIVERY_FAILED_BY_DRIVER`, `STATUS_DRIVER_ALMOST_AT_STORE`, `STATUS_DRIVER_ALMOST_AT_CUSTOMER`, `STATUS_CUSTOMER_ALMOST_AT_STORE`, `STATUS_CUSTOMER_AT_STORE`, `STATUS_DRIVER_AT_CUSTOMER` (11 locales, machine translation, no native speaker). Kept: the chat pill of a completed order stays "Order completed" (`ChatEnded.dc.html` draws it so); the four old pill keys keep their English in the catalog through a table in `Chat/changeEntries.ts` (the catalog takes the shared logic's English for a key the app no longer reads, and a key's English never changes). **Not touched:** the printed ticket (`src/printing/usePrinting.tsx` still writes `getOrderStatus` when no status is given: frozen). Tests: `orderStatusName.test.ts` (every id, the catalog's English, one list for all readers), `OrderCard.test.tsx`, `changeEntries.test.ts`, `Chat.test.tsx`. **Seen:** Messages rows (`03`: "Picked up by customer", "Not picked up by customer", "Picked up by driver", "Delivered by driver"), History cards (`17-history`), the details' chip ("Accepted by business", `07`) |

With `keepEndInSight` off the second test fails. Not seen on a tablet |

## New findings

- **C (Messages):** a long status chip pushes the unread count under it ("Not picked up by customer" on #3113, `03`): the count wraps onto its own line instead of staying at the row's end. The wording is now shorter than the server's, but this one is still the longest.
- **C (process):** Fast Refresh keeps the screen's state when a file is saved, so a fix is seen on the state the old code left behind (item 2's stale card stayed after the fix was saved; a new details session got the copy). A fresh launch is needed to judge a fix about stored state.
- **A/B:** none new.

## What I changed in the local data

Three pending pickup orders accepted from their cards, 20 min: **#3569**, **#3568**, **#3567**. Marked ready: **#3567** and **#3114** (both from their details). **#3114** completed with "Picked up" (from its card). #3568 adjusted +5 minutes (an allowed change, stays accepted). No message sent, nothing rejected, no store or product changed, no driver assigned.

## What I did not see

An action from a **card** followed by the Messages tab after the fix (no data left; jest). Item 2's sequence **three times** (once before the fix, once after on another order). The login on a tablet; anything on Android; the second Android pass and the third tablet look (not received). The printed ticket's status word.
